a6b2052d66fa: Source tabs — gateway texts and the original language · translationCore 4 Help
409e4552518f: Your translation stays the same when you switch; only the source column changes.
3dece7da8454: In Translate, look at the tabs above the source column.
c999c767379e: Click ULT (the literal text), UST (the simplified text) or Greek. An Old Testament book has Hebrew instead of Greek.
db1b4818efb2: The caption under the tabs names the text and its version.
2ce85b8042c3: The sections follow the selected source. In Titus 1, ULT and UST start with 1–3, while Greek shows the whole chapter as 1–16.
252056729e99: Words in curly braces, such as {and}, are part of the source text. They mark words added to make the meaning clear.
883201366f8a: Some gateway languages name the first two tabs differently, for example GLT and GST.
2e5e7739fb44: The same tabs are in Understand.
fa9f82f61cc2: If a text is missing, the column says "This source is not available for this book." See Browse and download source texts.
